name: Bounded web research
description: Reads search snippets first and opens a page only when a snippet is not enough, with cached results and a spending limit on paid search.
purpose: Give the assistant current public facts for factual questions, at a low search spend per correct answer.
approach: Search public sources for a question and return only the passages needed to answer it.
out_of_scope: Fetching internal or private network addresses, and searching the web for questions a person's own files or cards answer.
milestones: 1. An answer phrase appears in the observation the planner sees for every public factual case in the live set, with search spend per correct answer recorded for each configured vendor.
knowledge: Dedicated search APIs return titles, links and snippets quickly and cheaply; provider-native grounding needs no extra key but costs more at volume. Web access is kept out of the composite retriever because broadcasting would fire paid searches on every corpus grep. Live measurement covers only the vendors configured in the environment, and fixture payloads prove handling, not relevance or freshness.
measures_of_success: An answer phrase appears in the observation the planner would see for public factual questions, at low spend per correct answer, with backend failures falling back cleanly.
parameters: Backend selection and fallback order, vendor keys and base addresses, number of results, per-page token budget, cache lifetime, and the page-fetch fallback provider.
inputs: One or more search queries, or a page address with a focus phrase.
outputs: One compact observation of title, link and snippet per hit with citable links, or focused page passages capped to a budget; an error observation on failure.
effects: Outbound network requests, spend on paid search calls, and cache writes in memory. Fetches are restricted to safe addresses.
usage_notes: Search first and fetch a page only when a snippet is not enough. Configure at least one backend and a fallback, and keep web access as its own planner read key rather than inside the composite.
